prompt: A frame grab of a 1980s regional TV weather forecast at 6 a.m., shot on a tube studio camera: warm colour, slightly bloomed, comet-tail smears trailing off the bright highlights. From the attached image take only the mask's layout: a thin cream-white ring tracing the edge of the face from brow to chin, and a small solid red rounded triangle well inside it, upper right of the picture, over his left eye. A single presenter stands side-on to a large blue chroma wall of soft blank weather blobs, sweeping one arm across it with a clicker, head and shoulders turned square to the lens. In his other hand a demonstration umbrella has just blown inside out in the gust from a desk fan on a stand just out of shot. Boxy double-breasted cream blazer with shoulder pads, dark brown polo neck, wide trousers, tight white cotton gloves running under the cuffs. His tangerine-orange neoprene hood is one smooth unbroken surface tucked into the polo neck. Flat bright fluorescent front key, hard rim light from behind, floor tape marks and a light stand at frame edge, framed waist-up. Thanks.

From the attached image take only the mask's layout: a thin cream-white ring tracing the edge of the face from brow to chin, and a small solid red rounded triangle well inside it, upper right of the picture, over his left eye. He presents a shiny gold piggy bank like a luxury item, shaking it hard beside his ear to prove it is completely empty. Oatmeal cardigan with a clip-on lapel mic, pale blue shirt buttoned to the top, neat slacks, smooth white satin evening gloves running under the cuffs, each with a small ring-and-triangle patch on the back. His baby-blue quilted satin hood is one smooth unbroken surface tucked into the collar. Big, even, warm soft-box light from both sides, shadowless, cosy and over-bright. A plain blank coral price-banner panel runs across the lower quarter of the frame. Thanks.
